title: Inference Stack Changes

lines: The inference stack changes case is open.

summary: The case is open on recent inference-serving changes across SGLang, vLLM, and LiteLLM. It follows SGLang’s denoising and OCR support, LiteLLM’s scanning and multi-worker hot-reload fix, and vLLM’s shared-indexer correction and AMD expert-parallel support.
body: The case is open on recent inference-serving changes across SGLang, vLLM, and LiteLLM. It follows SGLang’s denoising and OCR support, LiteLLM’s scanning and multi-worker hot-reload fix, and vLLM’s shared-indexer correction and AMD expert-parallel support.

clues.title: Exact attention for Wan denoising
clues.content: According to the note, SGLang submitted exact FA3 context attention with optional FP8 reference K/V, reportedly speeding Wan-Animate-2 denoising by 1.7x as stated at 15:17 Beijing time.

clues.title: Shared-indexer correction
clues.content: The note reports that vLLM fixed a bug causing DeepSeek-V3.2’s shared indexer top-k calculations to be incorrect under pipeline parallelism; the cited update was timestamped 14:47 CST.

clues.title: OCR support and LiteLLM safeguards
clues.content: At 10:07 China Standard Time, SGLang reportedly merged support for the Unlimited-OCR v2 model. In the same release window, LiteLLM added Ovalix-based scanning of files and tool calls, alongside a fix for hot reloading across multiple workers.

clues.title: vLLM candidate and AMD support
clues.content: vLLM released the v0.33.0rc3 candidate at 15:15 Beijing time, then merged AMD MORI EP V2 expert-parallel support at 16:54.
